## 2026-09-25 LangChain Blog

发现 5 篇新文章:

**New in LangSmith Engine: red teaming and automated testing**
📅 Thu, 24 Se
原文摘要：LangSmith Engine now includes Red Teaming to proactively detect agent issues and automated agent testing. Learn more about the Engine v2 release.
🔗 https://www.langchain.com/blog/langsmith-engine-v2-redteam

---

**Introducing LangSmith Fine-Tuning**
📅 Thu, 24 Se
原文摘要：LangChain introduces LangSmith Fine-Tuning and SmithTune, a CLI built for post-training models. Train specialized models without building data pipelines by hand.
🔗 https://www.langchain.com/blog/langsmith-fine-tuning

---

**Managed Deep Agents delivers a better user experience for agents in production**
📅 Thu, 24 Se
原文摘要：Managed Deep Agents is the simplest way to build, deploy, and run agents in production. The 0.8 release adds support for user-owned credentials, user-level memory, HTTP channels, file transfer in Slack and a pre-built tool for web search.
🔗 https://www.langchain.com/blog/langsmith-managed-deep-agents-whats-new

---

**Trajectories now in LangSmith: A readable view of every agent session**
📅 Thu, 24 Se
原文摘要：Trajectories in LangSmith provide a conversational view of an agent session. Trajectories make trace data easy to navigate and speed up debugging for long-running agents.
🔗 https://www.langchain.com/blog/langsmith-trajectories-tracing

---

**LangSmith Custom Apps: Build custom interfaces around your agent data**
📅 Thu, 24 Se
原文摘要：LangSmith Custom Apps lets you build the interface you want with your LangSmith data, publish it into your workspace, and skip the hosting, auth, and permissions work. Learn more.
🔗 https://www.langchain.com/blog/langsmith-custom-apps
